title.narrative: Promoting Innovative Financial Inclusion Program (Subprogram 2)

description.narrative: Subprogram 2 continues to support and complement the government's efforts to promote financial inclusion under its sustainable development strategy pursuant to Indonesia Vision 2045. Indonesia seeks to transform its financial inclusion reform program into a more evidence-based, cohesive, and coordinated development effort underpinned by digital transformation. This will include more focused initiatives to enhance access to financial services for population segments that are particularly vulnerable to financial exclusion—notably micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs); women; youth; and those living in rural areas across the country. These reforms are anchored in digital infrastructure, financial technology (fintech), and private sector collaboration, along with an enhanced regulatory framework for market conduct supervision and consumer protection. Efforts to increase financial and digital literacy to promote responsible financial inclusion will also be stepped up. The program will help raise the living standards of low-income populations, promote the development of MSMEs, increase employment opportunities, and reduce poverty and social inequality. It will also enhance climate and disaster resilience, boost economic recovery from the coronavirus disease (COVID-19) pandemic, and ultimately support a development pathway for Indonesia that is inclusive, resilient, and sustainable.
